Convert a logical vector or a vector of p-values or a correlation, difference, or distance matrix into a display identifying the pairs for which the differences were not significantly different. Designed for use in conjunction with the output of functions like TukeyHSD, dist (stats), simint, simtest, csimint, csimtest (multcomp), friedmanmc, kruskalmc (pgirmess).

name: r-multcompview
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.1-12" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-multcompview
  version: "{{ version|replace("-", "_") }}"

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/multcompView_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/multcompView/multcompView_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 444af930d0da731e9be1c191e8ca48acaafbe8a64ef82351f59f9c113c6065b0

build:
  noarch: generic
  number: 0
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/
  missing_dso_whitelist:
    - '*/R.dll'        # [win]
    - '*/Rblas.dll'    # [win]
    - '*/Rlapack.dll'  # [win]

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
    - cross-r-base {{ r_base }}    # [build_platform != target_platform]
  host:
    - r-base
  run:
    - r-base

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('multcompView')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('multcompView')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://lselzer.github.io/multcompview/
  license: GPL-2.0-only
  summary: Convert a logical vector or a vector of p-values or a correlation, difference, or
    distance matrix into a display identifying the pairs for which the differences were
    not significantly different. Designed for use in conjunction with the output of
    functions like TukeyHSD, dist (stats), simint, simtest, csimint, csimtest (multcomp),
    friedmanmc, kruskalmc (pgirmess).
  license_family: GPL2
  license_file:
    - {{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-2

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
